case.title: Applying for Elterngeld
case.summary: Elterngeld provides financial support for parents who work less or not at all to care for their child. You can apply for this benefit online or at your local Berlin authority after the child is born. The amount and duration depend on your pre-birth income and the specific variant of Elterngeld chosen.
